message: The 404 code 'stock.missing' is listed on routes 'deleteBin', 'deleteWarehouse', 'getBin', 'getWarehouse', 'updateBin', 'updateWarehouse', which also answer the derived notFound code, so they have two 404 codes.
fix: Add errorRoles: { notFound: stock.missing } on the member node of the collection that lists 'stock.missing', or allow seampact/not-found-role on the catalogue entry with a reason.
